description: Cards are bordered, white surface containers that group related content into header / body / footer regions. Unlike the alpaca theme (square corners, no shadow), this theme rounds the corners (radius-lg) and applies a soft gray drop shadow by default, with a 1px lighter-gray border. Body/header/footer padding is responsive (1.5rem at xxl, 1rem below).

always: Apply the base class `card` to the root container.
Place textual content inside a `card-body`; place captions in `card-header` / `card-footer`.
Use `card-title` for the heading element inside the body or header.
never: Do not put body text directly on the `.card` root — wrap it in `card-body`.
Do not invent shadow/border modifier classes; the nested SCSS (e.g. card-shadow-*) is not exposed as a usable selector in this build.
Do not add a color modifier class to a card — this theme has no contextual card colors.

a11y: Give a card a heading (e.g. card-title as an h2/h3) so assistive tech can navigate by structure.
If the whole card is clickable, wrap it in a single anchor or add a stretched link rather than nesting multiple interactive controls ambiguously.

region-padding.description: Responsive helpers that force a card to fill the column height at a breakpoint.

fill-lg.note: min-height 500px, grows to 100% height at lg and up.

fill-xl.note: min-height 500px, grows to 100% height at xl and up.

scroll.description: Fixed-height scrolling card (e.g. a search/results panel).

children.note: Top cap with lighter-gray background; holds a title or navigation.
Header variant whose bottom border is removed so a contained card-primary-navigation owns the divider.
Tab strip (uses .nav .nav-item .nav-link). Add .vertical-tab for a vertical rail or .caps-tab for uppercase labels.
Segmented tab row with vertical dividers between items.
Heading, 1rem / normal weight in this theme.
Bottom cap with lighter-gray background; typically holds actions.
